neighborhood.title: Queen Anne, in the heart of it
neighborhood.intro: Seattle's best-kept secret — independent cafes, boutiques, galleries and cultural venues, with Seattle Center at the end of the block and easy access to South Lake Union, Capitol Hill, Downtown and the waterfront.

features.title: Rooftop terrace
features.body: Panoramic skyline views, grills and seating — the whole city from your own roof.

features.title: 24-hour fitness center

features.title: Stainless steel kitchens
features.body: Stainless appliances, dishwashers and premium finishes. Select homes add kitchen islands.

features.title: Studios to two bedrooms

features.title: Pet friendly
features.body: Your dog gets Seattle Center and Kerry Park for a back garden.

features.title: Steps from Seattle Center
